result.title: Improving Zero-shot 3D Semantic Mapping in Offroad with Geometric Priors
result.summary: Semantic 3D mapping is a powerful representation that enables platform agnostic mobile robot navigation in challenging offroad conditions. Current vision foundation models can accurately predict semantics zero-shot on structured scenes but performance is compromised in natural environments. On the other hand, 3D point clouds encode valuable information for discriminating semantics in scenarios where vision foundation models fail. In this work, we propose fitting a sphericity-elevation distribution for each semantic class to act as geometric anchor. Only the points with the most confident vision foundation model predictions are considered when fitting to produce high quality geometric prior distributions. The geometric prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final semantic mapping. The proposed prior improves SAM3 baseline by +6.3 in mIoU and +8.9 in accuracy on the RELLIS-3D dataset, and by +1.7 in mIoU and +2.1 in accuracy on the WildScenes dataset. The source code will be made public upon paper acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向越野环境零样本 3D 语义建图：仅用视觉基础模型高置信预测的点，为每个语义类拟合球度-高程分布作为几何锚点，再与视觉预测融合得到语义地图，并在两个数据集上报告 mIoU 与精度提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线距离较远，但「按置信度筛选视觉预测、再用几何先验校正语义」可能为视觉证据筛选与几何一致性核验提供可核查的方法线索。
